evidence.truthBoundary: Bathymetry is seabed depth/product coverage, not ecological condition or event.
EUSeaMap is a broad-scale predictive habitat-map product, not direct field observation or current ecological condition.

correctionHistory: Initial empty-style request returned 2xx but appeared visually blank.
Network success was therefore explicitly downgraded from MAP_GREEN to SOURCE_LOADED.
Live GetCapabilities inventory exposed the provider-advertised style eusm2019_msfd_800.
Explicit provider style produced visible habitat raster on desktop and 390px mobile.
MAP_GREEN was granted only after visual inspection of the corrected evidence.

evidence.measure: AIS-derived fishing-vessel density; provider product expressed as hours per square kilometre per month and summarised as annual averages
evidence.truthBoundary: Historical/reference vessel-density context only. Not live fishing activity, catch, legality, illegal-fishing evidence or ecological impact.

correctionHistory: Initial annual-average layer requests were source-loaded but visually blank in the tested view.
Live WMS capabilities showed a time dimension with annual slices from 2017 through 2024.
The sandbox deliberately selected the 2023 slice instead of default 2024 because provider metadata reports reduced satellite-data density during part of 2024.
The explicit 2023 time parameter produced a visible fishing-vessel-density raster on desktop and 390px mobile.
MAP_GREEN was granted only after browser-network proof and human visual inspection.

evidence.adapterTests: AUTH gate, bounded z/x/y/date request, token URL exclusion, evidence redaction, coordinate validation
evidence.truthBoundary: Apparent fishing effort is AIS-derived algorithmic activity estimation and does not prove illegal fishing, legal liability, catch or complete vessel presence.
